matchKind.fuzzy: Matched to {category} by wording alone, scoring {score} of 100. Worth a look.

row.noOpportunity: Unable to match to an opportunity
row.duplicate: Identical to "{title}" earlier in this run. Repeated rows are dropped, so this one creates nothing.

uncollectedNote.search: No configured search term found these, so nobody looked for them; a second, wider read of the same window did. They are the only events here that can be added to the run by hand.
uncollectedNote.excluded: The title carries a term this deployment never collects, whatever else is true about the event. These cannot be added to a run.
uncollectedNote.allday: All day, so there are no times to build a shift from. These cannot be added to a run.
uncollectedNote.untitled: No title, so there is nothing to match an opportunity on, and nothing to note for the model either. These cannot be added to a run.
